description:
Straight kurta with scattered gold zari-style floral motifs on the body and sleeves, a slit band collar with striped gota placket, and parallel gota-style stripes at the cuffs and hem, layered over a pleated skirt-style lower piece.
Includes: kurta and flared pleated lower piece.
includes: kurta and flared pleated lower piece (skirt or palazzo, beige)
uncertain: exact embroidery thread type (zari vs resham)
whether gold stripes are gota patti or metallic ribbon trim
whether lower piece is a skirt or palazzo
whether lower piece is attached or separate
conflicts: Current description says printed cotton gown; photos show no print, and show a straight kurta with a separate/layered pleated lower piece, not a gown.
Current description says embroidery chanderi top; the kurta's sheer sleeves look chanderi-like, but the lower piece is a different plain beige fabric.
